expected_pin_nets.R_VC_INPUTS: R_VC0 pin1=SC_MINUS; R_VC1..R_VC7 pin1=T1..T7 respectively; R_VC16 pin1=SC_PLUS; each pin2=its VCn_FILT net. All use 100Ω.
expected_pin_nets.C_VC_FILTERS: C_VC0 between VC0_FILT and GND_SYS; C_VC1..C_VC7 each between VCn_FILT and VC(n-1)_FILT; C_VC16 between VC16_FILT and VC7_FILT. Nine 220nF caps total.
expected_pin_nets.AFE_SUPPLY: SC_PLUS -> D_AFE_BAT(A-K) -> R_AFE_BAT_SER(100Ω) -> AFE_BAT; C_AFE_BAT from AFE_BAT to GND_SYS. Separately SC_PLUS -> D_AFE_BREG(A-K) -> R_AFE_BREG_FEED(1kΩ/2W) -> Q_AFE_PRE.C; Q.B=AFE_BREG, Q.E=AFE_REGIN; R_AFE_BREG_PD 10M from AFE_BREG to GND_SYS; C_AFE_REGIN 22nF from AFE_REGIN to GND_SYS. REG1 and REG18 each have 4.7µF to GND_SYS. CP1-BAT has 1µF/25V. PACK via 10k from SC_PLUS.
expected_pin_nets.SAFE_GATE: DCHG and DDSG are healthy-high only under the contracted BQ configuration; each feeds one AND input and has its own 47k pulldown. MCU PERMIT through changed R_PB5_PERMIT=4.7k and TLV6700 OUTB share MCU_PERMIT_AFE; this third AND input has 47k pulldown. AND Y passes through 680Ω to DRV_FAULT_N; existing 10k R_DRV_FAULT_PD stays. No AND output may connect directly to the MCU/TLV open-drain node.
expected_pin_nets.BUS_DIVIDER: BUS_EXT -> R_BUS_HI2(150k) -> BUS_HI_MID -> existing R_BUS_HI(150k) -> BUS_ADC_RAW; existing R_BUS_LO(10k) and C_BUS_ADC remain from BUS_ADC_RAW to GND_SYS. The local BUS_EXT port at x1120,y1330 is to be relabelled BUS_HI_MID only after the new resistor is placed and routed.
expected_pin_nets.IMON_DIVIDER: DRV_SO -> existing R_DRV_SO_SER changed to 10k ±0.1% -> IMON_RAW; add R_IMON_PD 10k ±0.1% from IMON_RAW to GND_SYS; existing C_DRV_SO stays from IMON_RAW to GND_SYS; TMUX channel 3 connects IMON_RAW to IMON.
expected_pin_nets.SC_SUM_DIVIDER: SC_PLUS -> existing R_T8_HI 68k -> SC_SUM_RAW; existing R_T8_LO 10k and C_T8_FILTER remain from SC_SUM_RAW to GND_SYS; TMUX channel 2 connects SC_SUM_RAW to SC_SUM. Do not delete T8 divider.

required_unchanged_baseline_nets.C_BAL1..C_BAL8: Every pin remains as baseline: C_BAL1 1=T1/2=SC_MINUS; C_BALn (n=2..7) 1=Tn/2=T(n-1); C_BAL8 1=SC_PLUS/2=T7.
required_unchanged_baseline_nets.U_BAL1..U_BAL8: Every pin remains as baseline: U_BAL1 1=T1/2=SC_MINUS/3=SC_MINUS/4=NC/5=BAL1_IOUT; U_BALn n=2..7 has 1=Tn/2=T(n-1)/3=T(n-1)/4=NC/5=BALn_IOUT; U_BAL8 1=SC_PLUS/2=T7/3=T7/4=NC/5=BAL8_IOUT.

pre_execution_assertions: Reopen restored baseline in the parent-owned EDA session and capture a fresh official baseline netlist; verify current project UUID and page UUID first.
Before any delete, assert the exact 31 ref allowlist exists once each and every exact port ID/net/coordinate in the list matches baseline; abort on any difference.
Do not delete or modify any wire in the first old-network-removal batch. Dangling isolated stubs are acceptable until reviewed.
Search exact MPNs via lib_Device.search and pass the complete returned ILIB_DeviceSearchItem to sch_PrimitiveComponent.create. Never hand-build a short UUID object for library parts.

After each new complex component is instantiated, read back all pins and assert number/name/coordinate before routing. If symbol pin map differs from this plan or official datasheet map, stop and amend the contract first.

Save, close, reopen, export fresh official .enet; compare every pin of every retained unmodified ref with baseline. Only allow the explicit exception/deletion set above; separately assert all SC1..SC8, U_BAL1..8, C_BAL1..8, R_BAL1..8 and U1 unchanged.
DRC is a secondary check; it cannot replace per-pin netlist equivalence.
